# Gapwise

> When a patient cancels, you send the slot to Gapwise and waiting patients are texted until one takes it. $149 per practice per month, no contract.

Who it is for: Independent dental practices

Price: $149 per month. Month to month, no contract, no setup fee.

## Pages

- [Gapwise: fill cancelled dental slots](https://wayaframes.github.io/gapwise-demo/): When a patient cancels, you send the slot to Gapwise and waiting patients are texted until one takes it. $149 per practice per month, no contract.

## Common questions

**Q: Which patients do you text?**

A: Only people who agreed to hear from your practice. If we are not sure a patient agreed, we do not text them.

**Q: What if a patient does not want the texts?**

A: A patient can reply STOP and the texts stop.

**Q: What do you do with patient details?**

A: We never sell or share them, and we keep only what we need to send one text.

**Q: Is written consent needed in every state?**

A: We do not know yet. It needs a lawyer or a practice that knows the rules. We will not guess, and we will not text a patient unless we are sure they agreed.

**Q: Can I stop?**

A: Yes, whenever you want. It is month to month with no contract.
